instrument: Developer litigation against the City of Inver Grove Heights over the data center moratorium
summary: The developer, QLevr LLC, threatened suit citing damages up to $150 million because the moratorium was drafted after its application was filed, and filed suit once the moratorium took effect. City officials estimated the city could owe at least $20 million if it lost. The council then amended the moratorium to exclude the project (third reading Sept 14, 2026; one councilmember opposed).

source.citation: City of Inver Grove Heights update page; MPR News and CBS Minnesota, Sept 15, 2026

notes: Damages CONFLICT: developer communications cited up to $150 million (city page); city officials cited at least $20 million (MPR, Sept 15). Both recorded.
confidence_note: Complaint and case number not read; lawsuit filing and damages estimate reported.
